page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c48g1.12xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor. It features 48 dedicated physical cores running at 2.9 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, paired with 310.0 GB of system memory. The instance includes a single NVIDIA A10 GPU based on the Ampere architecture, providing 24 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local storage is not bundled with this instance, meaning storage requirements must be met via network-attached options. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate strong performance in specific cryptographic and decompression tasks, with the Passmark CPU encryption test and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression both scoring in the top 25 percent. The system's GPU acceleration delivers top-tier performance for large language model inference on small and medium models. Specifically, prompt processing for a 135M model reaches 9711.08 tokens per second, while a 7B model achieves 2509.43 tokens per second. General CPU and memory bandwidth benchmarks, including Geekbench multi-core and stress-ng tests, consistently fall within the average range.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, this instance offers a balanced allocation of dedicated compute resources and high-capacity GPU memory without the added cost of local NVMe storage. This makes it a viable option for workloads that rely on external storage systems. The hardware profile is highly suited for deep learning inference, medium-scale AI model serving, image processing, and parallelized data decompression tasks.
